question: The curved surface area of the sphere is 154 cm². Find the volume of the sphere (rounded off to one digit after decimal).
solution:
**Given:**

The curved surface area of the sphere is 154 cm2

**Concept used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

Volume of a sphere = 4/3πr³

Here,

r = radius

**Calculation:**

4πr² = 154

⇒ 4 × 22/7 × r2 = 154

⇒ r2 = 49/4

⇒ r = 7/2

So, volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (7/2)³

⇒ 4/3 × 22 × 49/8

⇒ 11 × 49/3

⇒ 539/3

⇒ 179.66 ≈ 179.7

**∴ The volume of the sphere is 179.7 cm³.**
